name: bilingual_AI_prompt_library
description: A practical bilingual AI prompt library designed to facilitate prompt engineering across domains such as work, learning, content creation, marketing, and everyday use.

inputs.name: user_intent
inputs.description: Description of the user's goal or the task to be accomplished using the prompt.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Relevant background information or situational details to tailor the prompt.

inputs.name: language_preference
inputs.description: Choice of language for the prompt (e.g., bilingual options reflecting the library's capabilities).

outputs.name: generated_prompt
outputs.description: An AI prompt specifically engineered for the described task, optimized for bilingual use.

patterns: Domain-specific prompt templates (work, learning, marketing, content creation)
Reusable prompt engineering structures adaptable for various use cases
steps: Identify the target task or objective for the prompt.
Select the appropriate bilingual or domain-specific prompt template.
Fill template placeholders based on user intent and context.
Generate the final prompt string in the desired language(s).
Use the prompt with an AI model to achieve the desired output.
use_cases: Generating task-oriented AI prompts for business and marketing campaigns.
Creating educational content prompts to aid learning and teaching.
Formulating content creation prompts for writing, social media, or blogs.
Everyday scenario prompts to improve daily productivity and workflows.
Supporting bilingual communication and content generation.

prompt_templates.name: task_description_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a detailed and clear AI prompt for the following task: {user_intent}. Include relevant context: {context}. Use {language_preference} language.

prompt_templates.name: marketing_campaign_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a persuasive marketing prompt targeting: {user_intent}. Background details: {context}. Provide output in {language_preference}.

prompt_templates.name: content_creation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write an engaging content creation AI prompt focusing on: {user_intent}. Include context: {context}. Output language: {language_preference}.

prompt_templates.name: learning_assistance_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Develop an instructional AI prompt to assist with learning: {user_intent}. Relevant info: {context}. Language preference: {language_preference}.
